name: Noo You
intro: A private observation log built around the approved Noo missions. Notice, record and revisit your own experience.
features: Save observations and use the existing filters to revisit them.
Use backup tools to keep a copy of your local log.
demo: Review the adult-use disclosure in the app before proceeding.
Choose an available mission and read its actual instructions.
Record what you noticed in your own words. This tour does not accept the disclosure or add an observation.
setup: Choose one approved mission to explore.
Locate the observation filters and backup controls.
boundary: Only the approved mission set is included. This is an observation prototype, not a clinical assessment, sensor system or treatment tool.
privacy: The walkthrough does not request sensor access or upload observations. Your consent choices remain yours.
